buyer_chat.question: What should I ask the seller?
buyer_chat.answer:
Ask the seller:
• What material is claimed, and what existing records or tests support it?
• What weight is documented, and does it include stones or other parts?
• Are there clear photos of the existing marks, fastening or setting, and any known repairs?

photo_chat.question: How should I photograph the clasp?
photo_chat.answer: Take a close photo of the clasp in soft, even light against a plain background. Keep the phone steady and tap the clasp to focus. Include the neighboring links so their connection is visible.
